recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future substantive PGx reporting guidance should be raised against current Clinical Genomics R6 artifacts or the Genomics Reporting/Molecular Definition IGs rather than restoring the old FHIR-11013 examples.
issue_request: FHIR-11013 was a Published/Persuasive Clinical Genomics DSTU2 issue requesting discussion, clarification, and PGx examples for diplotype/genotype/haplotype usage, with resolution to add examples and explanation for Sequence, Observation-genetics, DiagnosticReport-genetics, and DiagnosticRequest-genetics.
initial_application: Commit b2b49e7e2b explicitly resolved #11013 and added PGx examples for DiagnosticReport, DiagnosticRequest, Observation diplotype/haplotype/phenotype, Sequence, TPMT cases, and genomics.html guidance.
additional_context: Later genomics refactors intentionally retired the old DSTU2/R3-era clinical genomics core artifacts. Commit 3cfe12f1b4 removed outdated Observation, DiagnosticReport, and ServiceRequest genomics artifacts and streamlined genomics.html. Current fhir.ini comments out MolecularSequence and keeps MolecularDefinition active; hierarchy.xml still links the Genomics Implementer Guidance page; current MolecularDefinition sources include genotype, haplotype, CYP2C19, and Pgx-var examples, and genomics.html points to Genomics Reporting and Molecular Definition IGs for current structured guidance.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Restoring the original DiagnosticRequest/Observation-genetics examples would revive outdated artifacts, while current active core source already provides the appropriate modern PGx/genotype/haplotype coverage.
